To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have prepared novel alkali metal ionic liquids, and that they show ionic conductivity higher that 10−4S cm−1 at 20°C.
we have developed novel alkali metal salts that are liquid at room temperature and have high ionic conductivities.
we have developed the novel ionic liquids containing the alkali metal ions, such as lithium, sodium and potassium, as component.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new class of ionic liquids containing an alkali metal cation.
the synthesis and characterization of novel alkali metal salts with N-ethylimidazolium cation.
the synthesis of new ionic liquid, which is composed of the alkali metal cation, N-ethylimidazolium, and the hydrogen sulfate anion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the alkali metal sulfates of N-ethyl-3-methylimidazole are liquid at room temperature and have high ionic conductivities.
the alkali metal sulfates, especially lithium sulfate, can be considered as a promising candidate for the ionic liquid electrolytes.
the ionic liquids containing an alkali metal ion as component are novel and promising materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alkali metal ions in ionic liquids are not necessarily solid state, but liquid state at room temperatures.
alkali metals can be incorporated into ionic liquid state by the neutralization with imidazolium-based acidic compounds, such as N-alkylimidazole or N-alkylimdazole carboxylic acids.
alkali metal salts can be inherently liquid state when they are combined with N-alkylimidazole as anion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown for the first time that it is possible to make ionic liquid salts with alkali metals.
the combination of alkali metal ion with imidazolium cation is a very promising system for the development of novel ionic liquids.
it is possible to obtain ionic liquids with high ionic conductivity at low temperature by the combination of alkali metal ions and imidazolium cation.
